memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Osteoarthritis knee
  - Status: Right knee pain 3/10 on walking, morning stiffness <15 min, no effusion.
  - Plan: Continue paracetamol 650 mg SOS, topical diclofenac gel BD, calf‑strengthening exercises, order weight‑bearing X‑ray both knees.
- Chronic kidney disease
  - Status: eGFR 38 mL/min/1.73m2 (CKD G3b), urine ACR 45 mg/g, Hb 11.2 g/dL, asymptomatic.
  - Plan: Continue telmisartan 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD, furosemide 20 mg OD, sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD; monitor labs.
- Atrial fibrillation
  - Status: In sinus rhythm on apixaban 5 mg BD, heart rate 68 bpm on bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD, no dyspnoea.
  - Plan: Continue apixaban and bisoprolol; review INR only if warfarin started.
Due: Next HbA1c due 2025-07-05.
